text: (h) For purposes of section 1182(a)(2)(E) of this title, the term "serious criminal offense" means— (1) any felony; (2) any crime of violence, as defined in section 16 of title 18; or (3) any crime of reckless driving or of driving while intoxicated or under the influence of alcohol or of prohibited substances if such crime involves personal injury to another.
